en.headline: Crypto platform on alert lists opens Causeway Bay office
en.dek: Polar Tensor, listed by Hong Kong and Canadian regulators, opened an office at One Hysan Avenue in August, prompting experts to call for scrutiny of its marketing.
body: A cryptocurrency investment platform named Polar Tensor has opened an office in Causeway Bay, according to the South China Morning Post.
The company said it holds registrations in seven jurisdictions, including Hong Kong, Panama and the US states of Montana and Wyoming. It set up the office at One Hysan Avenue in August.

Polar Tensor appears on alert lists maintained by Hong Kong and Canadian regulators. Experts told the newspaper that presence on such lists does not prove wrongdoing, but urged a balance between an open business environment and closer oversight of how firms market regulated financial products.
A source told the South China Morning Post that the platform was being monitored by authorities.

zh.headline: 列入監管警示名單的加密貨幣平台在銅鑼灣開設辦公室
zh.dek: Polar Tensor 於 8 月在希慎道壹號開設辦公室，專家促請加強監察其推廣手法。
body: 《南華早報》報道，一家名為 Polar Tensor 的加密貨幣投資平台在銅鑼灣開設辦公室。
該公司稱在包括香港、巴拿馬以及美國蒙大拿州和懷俄明州在內的七個司法管轄區持有註冊。辦公室設於希慎道壹號，於 8 月開業。
Polar Tensor 出現在香港及加拿大監管機構的警示名單上。專家向報章表示，列入警示名單並不代表已違法，但促請在保持營商開放的同時，加強監察這類公司如何推廣受規管的金融產品。
消息人士向《南華早報》透露，該平台正受當局監察。
